label: Schedule
description: Starts the workflow on a schedule (once, every N seconds, or on a cron expression) with fixed inputs; it can still be run by hand. Output: {trigger, firedAt, inputs}.

ScheduleSpec.description: The kind's parameters — exactly the bridge's ``scheduled_tasks.schedule_spec``.

run_at.description: one_off: when to run (ISO 8601; without an offset it is UTC).
run_at.title: Run At

cron_expr.description: cron: a standard 5-field cron expression, read in `timezone`.
cron_expr.title: Cron Expr

ScheduleSpec.title: ScheduleSpec

configSchema.description: When the workflow runs on its own, and with which inputs.

assign.description: State fields to write after the node runs: {field: value}. Values are templates and may read {{output.<path>}}.
assign.title: Assign

schedule_spec.description: The kind's one parameter (see each field).

timezone.description: IANA timezone a cron expression is read in (default UTC). Ignored by the other kinds.
timezone.title: Timezone

inputs.description: Run inputs of a scheduled run: {input name: literal value}. Not templated.
inputs.title: Inputs

enabled.description: Off: the workflow keeps its schedule but never fires on it.
enabled.title: Enabled
